Description:
Phoenix Resource

Founded by Robrt Pela, a former staff writer for Previews and Reviews. Phoenix Resource was a lesbian/gay news and arts periodical that published biweekly. It is no longer active.

Staff:
Editor in Chief: Robrt L. Pela
Women’s Editor: Rae Fritz
Political Editor: Don Slutes
Photography Editor: Arthur Aboujrass
Photographer: Greg Lutz
Business Manager: D. Sean Kerfoot
Advertising Manager: Louis Clemente

Locations:
P.O. Box 5948, Phoenix, AZ 85010

Interesting Facts:
Published by Radical Phaerie Marketing, Inc. Published 229 issues before folding in 1994. Owner Robrt Pela became the president of the International Gay and Lesbian Press Association in 1989, during Phoenix Resource’s run.
